message.content:
An editorial illustration features two men facing each other in profile against a light blue background. On the left, a man with white hair and pale skin faces right. On the right, a man with dark hair and tan skin faces left. Both men wear white shirts. A white cloth, bearing the logo and text "KPK Komisi Pemberantasan Ko," is suspended between them. This cloth connects to both men's noses, which are unnaturally elongated and pass through or into the fabric, seemingly joining their faces.

Above the central figures, the large white word "TEMPO" is displayed. Below it, the text "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" appears in small white letters. At the top, headlines read "Compang-camping Tim Sukses Calon Presiden H. 40" and "Denda Keterlambatan Smelter Freeport H. 84." The central title is "SIAPA BERDUSTA PELEMAHAN KPK." A paragraph below this title mentions "Presiden Joko Widodo," "Komisi Pemberantasan Korupsi," "e-KTP," and "Cawe-cawe." In the upper right, publication details like "18-24 DESEMBER 2023," a barcode, and a QR code are visible.
